headline: Public march counters pro-deportation event in central Indiana
summary: On August 1, 2026, around 1,000 pro-immigrant protesters marched in Fishers, Indiana, countering a relocated, private pro-deportation event headlined by Greg Bovino. Speakers criticized the latter event's approach, comparing it to historical hate groups. The march was peaceful despite tension, ending early due to lightning.

headline: Will Caron: Troubled Waters
summary: The Hawaii State Department of Health has announced a $72 million deficit for FY 2021 due to increased COVID-19 response costs and decreased revenues. Governor Ige's proposed budget includes cuts to non-personnel expenditures, but not in health services or education. The state is also exploring potential federal relief funds.
